title: Tanvi Patri Secures Silver at Youth Olympics Badminton Final
indian_angle: India's Tanvi Patri achieved a significant milestone by winning a silver medal in women's singles at the Youth Olympics.
summary: Tanvi Patri settled for silver after losing to Zhang Yi Xin of China in the women’s singles badminton final at the Youth Olympics 2026 in Dakar, Senegal.

title: PV Sindhu Qualifies for BWF World Tour Finals 2026
indian_angle: Indian star PV Sindhu has secured her spot in the prestigious BWF World Tour Finals, marking her return to the event after five years.
summary: PV Sindhu has qualified for the BWF World Tour Finals in Hangzhou, returning to the event for the first time since 2021.

title: PV Sindhu: "31 is the New 21" as She Targets World Tour Finals
indian_angle: India's PV Sindhu expresses her determination to perform her best at the BWF World Tour Finals, stating her age won't hinder her top-10 comeback.
summary: The Indian star is back in the top-10 and wants to give her absolute best at the BWF World Tour Finals, embracing her age of 31.

title: Eligibility List Released for 49th Junior National Badminton Championships
indian_angle: The eligibility list for the upcoming 49th Junior National Badminton Championships in Sikkim has been released, detailing participants for this key domestic event.
summary: The Eligibility List for the Yonex-Sunrise 49th Junior National Badminton Championships 2026, scheduled from 14th to 21st November in Sikkim, has been released.

title: Badminton Association of India Forms New Athletes Committee
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India has officially announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee, aiming to enhance player representation and welfare.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced the formation of its Athletes Committee, a move aimed at strengthening player involvement in governance.
